echoParts: I lift up my eyes to the hills
From where does my help come?
My help comes from the Lord
verseText: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come? My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
meaning: When hard times come, we can look up to God for help. Since he made the whole world, he is strong enough to fix any problem!
